entries.conditions: DRQ int8 channelwise weights + fp32 activations: an FC on a rank-3 [1,T,C] input whose OUTPUT feeds an ADD (residual or two-input) aborts delegate kernel creation — ml_drift delegate_opencl 'Unable to parse bc coord for BATCH axis. Layout is bhwc' — and the whole CompiledModel GPU compile fails (no CPU fallback). Isolated rank-3 DRQ FC compiles; rank-2 FC+ADD compiles; the identical graph in f32 compiles. Kills every DRQ transformer/conformer block with residual FCs. Minimal repro: 1.0 MB x+Linear(x) tflite (parakeet-ja-work/drq_probes/bisect_resadd1_i8.tflite). Upstream answer (LiteRT #9277, 2026-10-01T03:50:26Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9277#issuecomment-5924359159): the error "is caused by MLDrift's batch broadcast coordinate parser failing when a rank-3 tensor is mapped to 4D `BHWC` during fused kernel codegen. Currently, using rank-2 or explicitly reshaping to a 4D tensor before the operation is the only workaround". Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).

evidence.source_model: parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja i8 DRQ + minimal probe bisect_resadd1_i8
